description.para: Provides the functions for the device as master, in xiicps_master.c.

briefdescription.para: Initiates an interrupt-driven send in master mode.

detaileddescription.para: It tries to send the first FIFO full of data, then lets the interrupt handler handle the rest of the data, if any.

parameterdescription.para: Number of bytes to be sent.
Address of the slave we are sending to.

simplesect.para: This send routine is for interrupt-driven transfer only.

briefdescription.para: Initiates an interrupt-driven receive in master mode.

detaileddescription.para: It sets the transfer size register so the slave can send data. The interrupt handler manages the rest of the work.

parameterdescription.para: Number of bytes to be received.
Address of the slave we are receiving from.

simplesect.para: This receive routine is for interrupt-driven transfer only.

briefdescription.para: Initiates a polled mode send in master mode.

detaileddescription.para: It sends data to the FIFO and waits for the slave to pick them up. If the master fails to send data due to arbitration lost, it stops the transfer and returns the arbitration lost status. If slave fails to remove data from FIFO, the send fails with time out.

parameterdescription.para: Number of bytes to be sent.
Address of the slave we are sending to.

simplesect.para: This send routine is for polled mode transfer only.

briefdescription.para: Initiates a polled mode receive in master mode.

detaileddescription.para: It repeatedly sets the transfer size register so the slave can send data to us. It polls the data register for data to come in. If the master fails to read data due to arbitration lost, it returns with arbitration lost status. If slave fails to send us data, it fails with time out.

parameterdescription.para: Number of bytes to be received.
Address of the slave we are receiving from.

simplesect.para: This receive routine is for polled mode transfer only.

detaileddescription.para: It enables slave monitor in the control register and enables slave ready interrupt. It then does an address transfer to slave. The interrupt handler signals the caller if the slave responds to the address transfer.

parameterdescription.para: Address of the slave to contact.

briefdescription.para: Handles interrupts for the master mode.

detaileddescription.para: The interrupt handler for the master mode does the protocol handling for the interrupt-driven transfers.
Completion events and errors are signaled to upper layer for proper handling.

The interrupts that are handled are:
DATA: This case is handled only for master receive data. The master has to request for more data (if there is more data to receive) and read the data from the FIFO.
COMP: If the Master is transmitting data and there is more data to be sent then the data is written to the FIFO. If there is no more data to be transmitted then a completion event is signaled to the upper layer by calling the callback handler.
If the Master is receiving data then the data is read from the FIFO and the Master has to request for more data (if there is more data to receive). If all the data has been received then a completion event is signaled to the upper layer by calling the callback handler. It is an error if the amount of received data is more than expected.
NAK and SLAVE_RDY: This is signaled to the upper layer by calling the callback handler.
All Other interrupts: These interrupts are marked as error. This is signaled to the upper layer by calling the callback handler.

briefdescription.para: Used to wait in polled function.
Sends the remaining data by refilling the transmit FIFO.

detaileddescription.para: This function waits until the transmit FIFO becomes empty and refills it with the remaining data. It continues until all the data is loaded into the FIFO or a transfer error occurs.

parameterdescription.para: Mask containing the transfer error interrupts.

simplesect.para: The latest interrupt status register value.

briefdescription.para: Waits for completion of a polled master send transfer.

detaileddescription.para: This function waits for the transfer-complete status and checks for arbitration lost, transmit overflow, NACK, and timeout conditions.

parameterdescription.para: Mask containing the transfer error interrupts.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the transfer completed successfully.
XST_FAILURE if the transfer timed out or another error occurred.
